family: LogisticRegression only; seven thermal and six each optional representations/regularizations
training: V4 train primary and train oil controls only. No old V2 training additions.
selection: Fixed C .03/.3/3, negative weights 1/3, thermal FOUR control, thresholds .2/.4/.6/.8/.9/.95/.98/.995 and persistence 3/6. Validation only.
thermal_rank: Number failed fixed primary gates; severe misses; total misses; false episodes/day; delay. Stable configuration order breaks ties.
optional_rank: Precision >=.8 and assessable-row recall >=.8, then whole-set F1, precision, false episodes/day. Coverage always reported; sensor absence cannot be cured by model.
labels: Thermal same-load excess >=2C sustained3 vs <=1C; oil physical inventory loss>=2L vs <=1L; terminal injected high-contact-resistance heating. Gray zones excluded. Latent values ONLY label construction.
test: Legacy sealed_acceptance already used in earlier rounds is regression only. Newly sampled six profiles and seeds are generated after model lock, once, same simulator; no field generalisation claim.
feature_logic: Extra sensors train separate optional LR heads, never contaminate thermal target; oil and terminal are suspected physical conditions, not confirmation of leakage/internal bushing cause.
kill_first: Verify data hashes and group isolation before fit; after lock suffix/prefix, oracle columns, missing/invalid sensors, availability, cadence, calibration, model tamper and serialization attacks.
oil_geometry: Fixed 190L reference, 30L effective gauge and beta .000725/K from V4 assumptions. Hardware calibration required before operational use.
unsupported: Tank pressure, internal bushing, calibrated vibration, measured hotspot/impedance and internal shorts have no trained detectors; external references excluded.
scores: uncalibrated detector scores, not failure probabilities
